newsitem.title: BAHRAIN: Bahrain stocks mark time in bank-dominated trade.
newsitem.headline: Bahrain stocks mark time in bank-dominated trade.

text.p: Bahrain's shares ended the week to Thursday little changed in more active trade focused on banks and investment firms, Bahrain Stock Exchange said.
It said the index crawled up 0.28 points to 1,492.80 points from 1,492.52 points the previous week.
The number of shares traded rose to 10.4 million from last week's 6.3 million. Shares of 19 companies changed hands in 141 transactions.
Banks and investment companies accounted for 54 percent of total trading value of 1.9 million dinars ($5 million), up from last week's 1.3 million.
Bahrain's Telecommunication Co (BATELCO) led trade, accounting for 26 percent of value dealt. It was last quoted at 422 fils.
Bahrain Middle East Bank followed, accounting for 19 percent of value trade. It closed at 87 fils.
After the previous week's active trade in Bahrain International Bank, the share was this week quoted nine fils weaker at 148 fils.
